title: Qualify post-M7 current Math solution and local package delivery without publication
commitMessage: docs: qualify post-M7 local delivery inventory without publication

contribution.summary: Conduct a current-source, no-publication Math delivery qualification after the completed M0-M7 roadmap. Audit 13 packable solution projects, 11 test projects and 47 historical local consumer directories; run a locked .NET restore, Release build and full solution tests, then inspect three fresh representative local preview NuGet archives without changing any DWF product node.
contribution.value: An independent read-only BCL C# inventory verifies real csproj PackageId/Version and safe references, 541 unchanged completed DWF nodes, RS123 first-pass truth, M5/M6 historical package evidence, M7 release deferrals and unsent recipient requests. The payload records exact command exits, output digests, actual SDK/RID and local package ZIP/nuspec/net10 assembly hashes for distribution, analysis and scientific. No cross-platform, full 13-package repack, Discovery delivery, source-free client rerun, public release or external adoption is asserted. The execution runs the distribution/analysis/scientific focused regressions before the full-solution suite to falsify likely failures first. RS124 first failed in payload preflight without an allocated attempt. This same-run correction uses SDK JSON arrays and read-only C# NuGet SHA inspection, with no direct filesystem mutation.
debtChanges: Historical M5/M6 source-free consumers are not rerun by RS124; 47 consumer directories are source inventory only.
Only three representative preview packages are freshly packed; the other ten packable projects retain source-declared metadata rather than new archive receipts.
The root README still describes the 2026-10-07 initial-plan state; public documentation and publication-readiness require a separate qualified scope.
Discovery agent surface remains a candidate without a generated skill or broker-ready bindings; AURA/Decision/MCDM requests remain unsent.
All 541 M0-M7 DWF nodes remain done. A future native-plan extension requires an accepted DWF planning mechanism; RS124 is no-progress evidence-only work.
contribution.nextAction: After the durable RS124 result, decide whether to extend to fresh source-free consumers and API/ABI inspection, coordinate owner-authorized AURA/Decision/MCDM requests, or approve a DWF-compatible new roadmap. Never infer public 1.2.0 or create M8 without explicit supported planning authority.
